name: copywriting-kit
description: Conversion copywriting for your own small-business or SaaS website: edit, diagnose and rewrite SaaS landing page copy, a sales page, homepage headline, pricing or about page. Edited text first with every number, name and claim kept, a plain diagnosis of what is broken (positioning, value proposition or messaging) before any rewrite, claims checked against your evidence, page drafts from your facts, and a brand voice guide from your own writing. Proof, testimonials and urgency are never invented. Network use: copy-diagnose reads public pages you link. Most answers (copy with claims, testimonials, reviews or urgency lines; headlines, value propositions and page reviews; every voice profile) cite the official page used (for example ftc.gov, eur-lex.europa.eu, legislation.gov.uk, gov.uk or asa.org.uk) for you to open; because those rules are dated, it may also offer to check the most recent dated copy on the author's page, https://black-vector.com/copywriting/claims, and fetches that page only after you say yes.
